name: nextkube
description: High-performance standalone Kubernetes cluster operations & management console built with Next.js and Material-UI

scripts.postbuild: mkdir -p .next/standalone/.next && cp -r .next/static .next/standalone/.next/ && ( [ -d public ] && cp -r public .next/standalone/ || mkdir -p .next/standalone/public ) && mkdir -p .next/standalone/node_modules/node-pty && ( [ -d node_modules/node-pty/build ] && cp -r node_modules/node-pty/build .next/standalone/node_modules/node-pty/ || true ) && ( [ -d node_modules/node-pty/prebuilds ] && cp -r node_modules/node-pty/prebuilds .next/standalone/node_modules/node-pty/ || true )
